svg.title: Simplified SOP RAG System Flow v3
svg.desc: End-to-end flow from Confluence and Shared Drive through ingestion, AI embedding, AI orchestration, API layer, to a single unified web UI

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the Confluence connector work?')
sendPrompt('How are shared drive files ingested?')
sendPrompt('How does OCR handle screenshots in SOPs?')
sendPrompt('What is stored in the object store?')
sendPrompt('What is the role of QWEN or open-source GPT in embedding?')
sendPrompt('Why is ChromaDB used as the vector store?')
sendPrompt('How does the retriever engine search the vector DB?')
sendPrompt('What does the citation-first prompt template look like?')
sendPrompt('How is confidence scored and what triggers a manual review?')
sendPrompt('What APIs are exposed to the UI?')
sendPrompt('What does the chat interface look like for operations staff?')
sendPrompt('How does the validation workbench work in the UI?')
sendPrompt('What admin and consolidation tasks can team leads do?')

svg.text: 🔒 All processing within bank network — no external data egress
